notes.title: Update 1.1.6 - Paintings puzzle update & Server capacity increased
notes.content:
Hey!
We have great news for you!

PAINTINGS PUZZLE:
We listened to our community and updated the picture puzzle. Now it is more intuitive than before, but we have not upset its functioning. We believe that it is the right compromise between those who considered it feasible and stimulating and those who considered it without logical sense.

We look forward to your feedback!


SERVER CAPACITY:
We have increased the server capacity again! The game can now be played with up to 600 concurrent users. We hope to exceed this limit as well, but we think you will never see the server queue screen again.

Thanks for your support and enjoy!

notes.title: Update 1.1.5 - Bug fixing & Improvements
notes.content:
1- Fixed a bug for medium and high quality that prevented you from seeing the symbols on the keys while holding them
2- Added the ability to leave the game while in queue
3- Fixed a bug which prevented, in some situations, repositioning a hand on the pendulum after removing it
4- Limited frame rate while not in game
5- Small improvement on paintings puzzle
6- Controller inputs no longer interfere with mouse movement 
7- Minor bug fixing

notes.title: Update 1.1.4 - Server Capacity Improved
notes.content:
We are very sorry about server inconvenience. We have improved from 50 concurrent users to 100 with this update. The negative reviews about the queue problem in the server let us down, but anyway we are very happy about the number of players we reached.

Update Log:
1. Server Capacity increased
2. Links on Main Menu
3. Changed Emily's sheet location
4. Fixed a problem with the camera while looking at the ground
5. Minor bug fixing
